message: I remember the time my smoke alarm decided to get a little too dramatic while I was making dinner. The family group chat exploded with emojis and jokes about my ‘smoky masterpiece’ while I was frantically waving a dish towel! 😅 It reminded me how important it is to have a kitchen safety plan and a family escape route that we all know by heart—just in case things get a little too heated. Ever had a funny kitchen mishap?
